config.purpose: Prove that persistent project memory improves a later session: phase A/C discovers an undocumented codegen step; phase B/D must apply it after a source change, once with the memory the learn phase produced and once with it wiped. Two independent traps (schema codegen, i18n catalog).
config.subject: agent_memory
config.note: Compare b-recall-with-memory against b-recall-without-memory on oracle pass, steps, and tokens. One run is one sample; repeat runs before drawing conclusions.

scorePolicy.note: Same provisional policy as the core suite so task rows stay comparable.

tasks.prompt: Implement formatUser in src/user.ts: return the user's fields in schema order as key=value pairs joined by '; ' (for example id=u1; name=Ada; createdAt=2026-01-01), using USER_FIELDS from the generated schema module. Do not modify tests or schema/model.json. Run bun test before completing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The external oracle verifies the generated schema matches schema/model.json and formatUser produces the documented format.
The fixture's visible Bun tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Add a trailing string field named email to the User type in schema/model.json and make sure formatUser includes it in its output. Do not modify tests. Run bun test before completing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The external oracle verifies the schema gained email, the generated module was regenerated (hash matches), and formatUser includes email.
The fixture's visible Bun tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Implement t in src/i18n.ts: look up the key in the generated message catalog (MESSAGES), replace every {param} placeholder with the matching value from params, and return the key itself when it is not in the catalog. Do not modify tests. Run bun test before completing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The external oracle verifies the message catalog was generated (hash matches locales/en.json) and t interpolates, reads the catalog, and falls back to the key.
The fixture's visible Bun tests pass.
